notes: «قرأته في أصل إسماعيل» reads the report from the written source of Isma'il: he is read as a transmitter, and the gloss «- يعني ابن عياش -» is left out
«ثم العوفي» after the nisba is not part of the surface (a second nisba after «ثم»); it is noted here and not added
«قال أبو داود قال سليمان ... له عندنا صحبة» is the compiler's comment and is not a link
The Prophet's words are relayed by Malik b. Yasar, the last link
